title: Diagrams from the document bar
prompt:
# Story: Diagrams from the document bar

- **Story**: XXX-story-diagrams
- **Created**: 2026-11-28
- **Status**: Draft
- **Demo**: open a story with no diagram, generate a sequence diagram from the Diagrams menu and add it; reload and see its button in the
  story; open it and see "No request was made"; regenerate and replace it; add a class diagram; remove the sequence diagram; sync and see
  `diagrams/class.mmd` on GitHub while `story.md` is unchanged.

## Story

As a team member, I want to generate a sequence or a class diagram of an open story from its bar, look at it on a full screen, and keep it
with the story, so that the pair that builds the story sees who talks to whom and which classes it needs, drawn the way our architecture
and linked ADRs say.

## Acceptance tests

The Diagrams button and its menu

- [ ] **Given** an open story, **Then** the bar shows "Diagrams" with the workflow icon and a down arrow.
- [ ] **Given** an open architectural enabler, driver or ADR, **Then** there is no Diagrams button.
- [ ] **When** the user presses Diagrams, **Then** a menu labelled "Diagrams" opens below it with two items, in this order: "Sequence
  diagram" ("Who talks to whom, step by step. Not a C4 diagram, drawn in the C4 style.") and "Class diagram" ("The classes and interfaces
  behind the story (C4 code level)."), each with its icon.
- [ ] **Given** the story holds a diagram of that kind, **Then** its item has the chip "In the story" and the line "Open the diagram that
  the story holds." instead of the description.
- [ ] **When** the user presses Escape, clicks outside the menu or presses Diagrams again, **Then** the menu closes.
- [ ] **When** the user picks an item, **Then** the menu closes and the full screen of that kind opens.

Generating a diagram on the full screen

- [ ] **Given** the story does not hold a diagram of the picked kind, **When** it is picked, **Then** a full screen dialog opens above the
  builder with the icon and title of the kind, the chip "Generated", the path of the story, the C4 colour legend (Person, Software system,
  Container, Component, External) and "Drawing the diagram...", and a request is sent to Claude.
- [ ] **Given** the request, **Then** it holds the kind, the path of the story, the text of the story as it is in the editor (even unsaved),
  the full text of the documents linked to it, the ADRs a linked enabler derives from, and the project context with its principles and its
  architecture. The system prompt asks for Mermaid only, in the C4 conventions, with at most eight elements.
- [ ] **While** Claude answers, **Then** the Mermaid source shows as it streams, open, and the footer shows only "Stop".
- [ ] **When** the user presses Stop, **Then** the request ends and the screen says "Stopped before the diagram was complete."
- [ ] **When** the answer is complete, **Then** the source is cleaned of any code fence, the diagram is drawn on white with Mermaid in the
  C4 palette, fitted to the width, the source is folded, and the footer shows the input, output, cache read and cache write tokens.
- [ ] **Given** Claude returned nothing, **Then** the screen says "No diagram was received from the model." **Given** the request failed,
  **Then** the screen shows its error.
- [ ] **Given** Mermaid cannot draw the source, **Then** the screen says "The diagram could not be drawn: <error>", opens the source, and
  shows "Ask Claude to fix it", which sends the error back to Claude in the same conversation and draws the corrected source.

What the full screen offers

- [ ] **Given** a drawn diagram, **Then** "Fit to width" and "Actual size" switch its size; "Fit to width" is the default.
- [ ] **When** the user presses "Copy source", **Then** the Mermaid source is copied and the button says "Copied" for a moment.
- [ ] **When** the user presses "Regenerate", **Then** the same request is sent again, from scratch, and the chip says "Generated".
- [ ] **When** the user presses the close button or Escape, **Then** the full screen closes, any request in progress is stopped, and the
  story is unchanged.

Adding the diagram to the story

- [ ] **Given** a drawn diagram and the story holds none of that kind, **Then** the main button says "Add to story". **When** it is pressed,
  **Then** the diagram is stored with the story and the full screen closes.
- [ ] **Given** the story holds a diagram of that kind and the one on screen is different, **Then** the main button says "Replace in
  story", and pressing it replaces the stored one.
- [ ] **Given** the one on screen is the one the story holds, **Then** the main button says "In the story" and is disabled.
- [ ] **Given** nothing is drawn yet, or the source does not render, **Then** the main button is disabled.
- [ ] **Given** the story holds a diagram of that kind, **Then** "Remove from story" shows. **When** it is pressed, **Then** the diagram is
  removed from the story and the full screen closes.

The diagrams in the story

- [ ] **Given** the story holds one or more diagrams, **Then** below the header it shows the section "Diagrams" with one button per
  diagram, sequence first, each with the icon and label of its kind.
- [ ] **Given** the story holds no diagram, **Then** the section is hidden.
- [ ] **When** the user presses the button of a diagram, or picks a kind the story holds in the menu, **Then** the full screen opens with
  the stored diagram, the chip "From the story" and the footer "Drawn from the story. No request was made." No request is sent.
- [ ] **Given** the stored diagram is open, **When** the user presses Regenerate or "Ask Claude to fix it", **Then** Claude continues as if
  it had drawn the stored one, and the chip changes to "Generated".

A diagram is stored with the story at once

- [ ] **Given** the user added, replaced or removed a diagram, **Then** the story's diagrams are stored in the project's database at once,
  without pressing Save, and no request is made to GitHub.
- [ ] **Given** the user added a diagram, **When** the page is reloaded or the story is closed and opened again, **Then** its button is in
  the story and it opens with the same source.
- [ ] **Given** the text of the story has unsaved changes, **When** the user adds a diagram, **Then** the diagram is stored and the text
  keeps its unsaved changes.
- [ ] **Given** the user added, replaced or removed a diagram, **Then** the Markdown text of the story is unchanged.
- [ ] **Given** the user deletes the story, **Then** its diagrams are deleted with it, and the confirmation says so ("together with its
  diagrams").

On GitHub

- [ ] **Given** a story with a diagram, **When** it is synced, **Then** the diagram is written as `diagrams/sequence.mmd` or
  `diagrams/class.mmd` in the story's folder, with the trimmed source and a final newline, and `story.md` is not changed by it.
- [ ] **Given** a pull brings `diagrams/<kind>.mmd` for a story, **Then** that diagram is stored with the story here and its button shows.
  A kind the pull does not bring is kept as it is here.

## Business rules and constraints

- **Two kinds, one of each.** A story holds at most one sequence diagram and one class diagram. Its diagrams are its Mermaid source by
  kind; the drawing is made from the source each time it is shown.
- **What is stored is what the user added**, not a draft that is being generated or shown on the full screen.
- **A stored diagram is never generated again by opening it.** Only Regenerate and "Ask Claude to fix it" send a request.
- **Diagrams are stored on every change**, like the tasks, links and UI example of the story. Only the text of the story waits for Save.
- **Diagrams are not part of the Markdown.** They live in the story's record in the database and in `diagrams/` on GitHub.
- **The diagram follows the project.** The request carries the linked documents, the principles and the architecture; Claude must not
  contradict an accepted ADR nor name a technology none of them names.
- **Mermaid draws in strict security mode**, and is loaded only the first time a diagram is drawn.
- **Only stories have diagrams.** Enablers, drivers and ADRs do not.

## Out of scope

- Other kinds than sequence and class (C4 context, container, component).
- Editing the Mermaid source by hand on the full screen.
- Asking Claude for a change to a diagram in words (only Regenerate and Fix).
- Exporting the diagram as an image.
- Deleting `diagrams/<kind>.mmd` on GitHub when a diagram is removed here: as in the spike, a file that is only missing here is left alone
  by Sync.
- The icons of the diagrams the story holds on the Diagrams button (story 1 of `story-document-bar-and-branch-sync.md`).

## Tasks

- [ ] Add `diagrams` (Mermaid source by kind, sequence and class) to the story in the database, with the endpoint that sets or removes the
  diagram of one kind.
- [ ] Add the Diagrams button and its menu to the story's `DocumentActionBar`, with the "In the story" chip for the kinds it holds.
- [ ] Build the diagram request (kind, path, editor text, linked documents, ADRs through linked enablers) and send it with the diagram
  system prompt and the project context (principles, architecture), streaming the answer and cleaning the code fence.
- [ ] Build the full screen dialog: title and origin chip, C4 legend, streaming state, Stop, Mermaid drawing with fit and actual size,
  render error with "Ask Claude to fix it", source, usage, Regenerate, Copy source, Close and Escape.
- [ ] Add "Add to story", "Replace in story", "In the story" and "Remove from story", storing the change at once without touching the text.
- [ ] Show the Diagrams section in the story, opening a stored diagram without a request and keeping the conversation for Regenerate and
  Fix.
- [ ] Write `diagrams/<kind>.mmd` on sync and read it back on pull; delete the diagrams with the story.
- [ ] Test the menu, generate, stop, fix, add, replace, remove, reload, opening a stored diagram without a request, and the `.mmd` round
  trip.

tasks.text: Add a `diagrams` column (Mermaid source keyed by kind: `sequence`, `class`) to the story entity in `bwyn-core` and write the Flyway migration that adds the `story_diagrams` table (ADR-0010, ADR-0017).
Implement the outbound adapter in `bwyn-infrastructure` that persists and retrieves diagrams for a story (ADR-0011, ADR-0017).

Implement the application-layer command handlers for set-diagram and remove-diagram in `bwyn-application`, and the inbound REST adapter endpoints in `bwyn-rest` with OpenAPI annotations (ADR-0008, ADR-0014, ADR-0017).
Extend the story deletion handler to cascade-delete diagrams and update the confirmation message to say "together with its diagrams" (ADR-0017).
Add `diagrams` to the story's domain model on the frontend (`entities` layer) and extend the `StoryRepository` port to load and save diagrams (ADR-0007, AE-0002).

Implement `DiagramViewModel` in the interface-adapter layer: holds the current kind, stored diagrams, generation state (idle / streaming / complete / error / stopped), source, token usage, and conversation history for Fix (ADR-0007, AE-0002).
Build the Diagrams button and its two-item menu in the `DocumentActionBar` UI component, showing the "In the story" chip for kinds the story already holds (ADR-0007, AE-0002).

Build the diagram full-screen dialog UI component: title, origin chip ("Generated" / "From the story"), C4 legend, streaming source view, Stop, Mermaid renderer (strict mode, lazy-loaded), render-error state with "Ask Claude to fix it", source fold/unfold, token footer, Fit to width / Actual size, Copy source, Regenerate, Close and Escape (ADR-0005, ADR-0007).

Implement the diagram request builder: assembles kind, story path, editor text, linked document texts, ADRs through linked enablers, principles, and architecture; sends to Claude with the C4 Mermaid system prompt; streams the answer; strips code fences (ADR-0007).

Implement "Add to story", "Replace in story", "In the story" (disabled), and "Remove from story" actions in the full-screen dialog, calling the ViewModel which calls the backend endpoint immediately (ADR-0007).
Show the Diagrams section in the story panel (sequence first); opening a stored diagram must not send a request; Regenerate and Fix must resume the conversation (ADR-0007, AE-0002).

Extend the sync adapter to write `diagrams/sequence.mmd` and `diagrams/class.mmd` in the story's folder on push, and to read them back on pull, storing the result without touching `story.md` (ADR-0017).

Write Jest tests covering: menu rendering, "In the story" chip, generate flow, Stop, Mermaid render error and Fix, Add / Replace / Remove, reload persistence, opening a stored diagram without a request, and the `.mmd` round-trip (Practice: Continuous integration, ADR-0005).

Add a `diagrams` column (Mermaid source keyed by kind: `sequence`, `class`) to the story entity in `bwyn-core` and write the Flyway migration that adds the `story_diagrams` table (ADR-0010, ADR-0017). _(As the `story_diagram` table in `V25__keep_story_diagrams.sql`, whose `kind` accepts only `sequence` and `class`, and `diagrams` on `ApprovedStory`.)_

Implement the outbound adapter in `bwyn-infrastructure` that persists and retrieves diagrams for a story (ADR-0011, ADR-0017). _(`StoryRepository.replaceDiagrams`, in `StoryRepositoryAdapter` with `StoryDiagramJpaRepository`.)_

Implement the application-layer command handlers for set-diagram and remove-diagram in `bwyn-application`, and the inbound REST adapter endpoints in `bwyn-rest` with OpenAPI annotations (ADR-0008, ADR-0014, ADR-0017). _(`SetStoryDiagramCommandHandler`, `RemoveStoryDiagramCommandHandler`, and `PUT` / `DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/stories/{id}/diagrams/{kind}`.)_

Extend the story deletion handler to cascade-delete diagrams and update the confirmation message to say "together with its diagrams" (ADR-0017). _(The foreign key removes the diagrams with the story; the message and the confirmation say "together with its diagrams".)_

Implement `DiagramViewModel` in the interface-adapter layer: holds the current kind, stored diagrams, generation state (idle / streaming / complete / error / stopped), source, token usage, and conversation history for Fix (ADR-0007, AE-0002). _(As `StoryDiagramViewModel`; a stopped request is the error state with the message "Stopped before the diagram was complete.")_

Build the Diagrams button and its two-item menu in the `DocumentActionBar` UI component, showing the "In the story" chip for kinds the story already holds (ADR-0007, AE-0002). _(The menu of story 047, now wired to the diagrams the story holds.)_

Implement the diagram request builder: assembles kind, story path, editor text, linked document texts, ADRs through linked enablers, principles, and architecture; sends to Claude with the C4 Mermaid system prompt; streams the answer; strips code fences (ADR-0007). _(The request is built in the backend, which reads the linked documents (`DiagramPrompts`, document type `story-diagram` of the existing streaming endpoint); the frontend `DrawDiagramUseCase` streams it and `cleanSource` strips code fences.)_

Write Jest tests covering: menu rendering, "In the story" chip, generate flow, Stop, Mermaid render error and Fix, Add / Replace / Remove, reload persistence, opening a stored diagram without a request, and the `.mmd` round-trip (Practice: Continuous integration, ADR-0005). _(In `story-diagrams.acceptance.test.tsx`; the `.mmd` round-trip is tested in the backend, which writes and reads the files: `SyncDocumentTest` and `DocumentSyncIT`.)_
